messages:
samir: FYI product wants shareable dashboards per-customer with telemetry and audit trails. We need runtime + infra constraints. Who can weigh in on available metrics and RBAC?

maria_p: use-cases: 1) customer-facing view for usage/cost 2) internal SRE view with latency/kcache breakdown 3) audit exports for compliance. Will customers need raw logs?

leo_k: runtime can expose per-request latency, per-model kv-cache hit rate, batch sizes, and quantization mode. We tag requests with tenant_id and route_policy.

anya: infra: we have immutable audit logs with request_id, tenant_id, actor, action, and S3 export pipeline. Exports are sensitive — PII must be redacted before export.

jessica_research: For evals we also need prompt hash -> quality metrics. That's PII-sensitive if prompts contain user data. We should add a scrub step.

samir: important: product wants a 'share link' that customers can give to their org. That implies a permission scope for shareable dashboards vs internal-only dashboards.

leo_k: agree. On the runtime side we can add a view filtering layer that maps a dashboard query to a tenant-scoped dataset. But masking rules (no raw prompts) need to be enforced upstream.

anya: infra suggests two-level RBAC: 'viewer' and 'auditor' for customer orgs; 'internal_sre' and 'platform_admin' for internal. Auditors get exports but with redaction toggle off only with legal approval.

samir: can we represent RBAC as simple roles + resource tags? e.g., dashboard:{id}:access -> [roles]

leo_k: yeah. Example policy snippet:
```
{"resource":"dashboard:1234","roles": ["viewer","org_admin"],"owners": ["maria_p"]}
```

maria_p: UX asks: if a user A shares with external vendor, we need an audit event and expiration on the share link. Also 'view-as' to preview customer-facing view.

anya: infra-bot: export-pipeline:policy-check PASSED for redaction=on. :gear:

jessica_research: question: how do we handle historical telemetry? Customers expect 90-day retention; internal SRE needs 365. Different retention per role?

anya: retention is per dataset. We can enforce retention on the storage tier and reflect policy in the console. Need legal for 365 on PII-derived metrics.

samir: action items: 1) eng-runtime (leo_k) document metrics telemetry and tag contract by EOD Fri. 2) infra (anya) list export/redaction constraints + retention options. 3) product (maria_p) draft share link UX and expiration requirements. 4) security/research (jessica_research) propose prompt-scrub rules.

maria_p: adding: need audit trail UI showing who shared what, when, and link expirations.

leo_k: small note: per-request sampling for heavy metrics to keep cost down — we'll include a sampling flag.

samir: thanks all. syncing with security on Monday; tag any follow-ups here. :thumbsup:
